items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 August 2026 4:17am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 02 August 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind warning for overnight.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure over the Norwegian Sea and to the northwest of Iberia. High pressure to the southeast of Greenland, with a ridge to Brittany.


##Wind##

Mainly variable 3 or less, settling mainly east or southeast this morning, then east or northeast 2 to 4 during this afternoon, becoming mainly northeast 3 or 4, occasional 5, later in the evening, then increasing overnight to 4 or 5 occasionally 6.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Mostly fair, with just patchy rain later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in places later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, decreasing 3 or 4 in the afternoon, veering southeast overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain becoming more widespread later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
